definitions.explanation: Taking action before the other party, gaining the advantage by acting first.
The player who makes the first move in board games such as shogi or go.

examples.japanese: {先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to seize the initiative before your opponent.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: We announced the new product before our rival company could beat us to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先手|せんて}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'll go first this time, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先手|せんて}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In shogi, the first player is considered to have a slight advantage.

examples.japanese: ⟦じゃんけん→じゃんけん：06520_janken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{先手|せんて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The one who wins rock-paper-scissors goes first.

notes:
WRITING:
{先|せん} (ahead/first) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand/move). Literally "first hand."

USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 1) is widely used in business, strategy, and everyday life. {先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ and {先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ are the most common set phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to make a preemptive move
- {先手|せんて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to seize the initiative
- {先手|せんて}{必勝|ひっしょう}: "first move wins" (strategic principle)
